precepts.text: Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom. Now we have context; no one can say we are making it up.
precepts.point: The Lord told Ezekiel to set his face against Mount Seir and prophesy against it. When the Bible prophesies against Seir, it is prophesying against Esau. That is what we are doing today.

note.label: The Religious Peer Pressure of Fred Price Jr

precepts.why:
The Lord told Ezekiel, “set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it.” Who or what is mount Seir? Genesis 36 answers: “Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.” Esau's dwelling is Seir, so when the Bible prophesies against Seir, it is prophesying against Esau, the nation of Edom. Now there is context, and no one can say we are making it up. We don't need a cosigner; the Bible says what it says.

With that key, Ezekiel 35 opens up. “Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred”: a hatred that has gone on for centuries, from Esau their father to his children toward us. It is in their blood to hate us; their hatred is damn near biological, from the womb to the tomb. That is why they do such terrible things to us: eating us, hanging us, castrating us, raping us, mutilating us. A sister whose husband was murdered sought justice in court; they hung her from a tree, shot her full of holes, cut the unborn baby out of her, stepped on its head and set it on fire. Damn! That is a perfect hatred. There's no record of black folks ever doing that to white folks. What we did to the French in Haiti was retaliation, and they deserved it; she was innocent.

They shed our blood “in the time that their iniquity had an end”: after the Emancipation Proclamation came the KKK, Black Codes, Jim Crow, convict leasing and redlining. That envy goes back to the birthright. Esau was the firstborn and felt it was not fair that God chose Jacob, and the Lord says he will do “according to thine anger, and according to thine envy.”

Edom said, “These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it.” The two nations are Judah and Israel; the two countries were Judea and Samaria and later Israel and the Americas. They took one as Romans and later as Israelis, and the other as Christians, as conquistadors. “I have heard all thy blasphemies”: this is a direct precept to Revelation 2:9 and 3:9, the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews and are not, possessing the land and professing to be the people that belong there. They have said it to our faces: yes, you are the real Jews, but the land is ours now. They know; the world does not.

“When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate.” As long as that nation is on the earth, there can be no peace; when there is no more Edom, the earth rejoices. “thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Idumea, even all of it.” The judgment on Edom is complete, with no exceptions, and they shall know that he is the Lord.

note.label: I Come In Peace

precepts.why:
Malachi moves from one name to the other. God says “Was not Esau Jacob’s brother? saith the Lord: yet I loved Jacob, And I hated Esau,” and then in the next breath, “Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished.” He goes from Esau to Edom because they are the same man. Genesis 36:8 settles it: “Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.” There is no argument. Esau is Edom, the one who came out of his mother red, hairy like a garment, and whose name was changed to Edom, meaning red. He became the father of the Edomite nations.

So when Malachi says “I loved Jacob,” it is Jacob and all his descendants, the twelve tribes, the whole nation of Israel. When he says “I hated Esau,” it is Esau and all his nation. God does love us, even though, looking at our condition in the ghetto with everything going wrong, we ask “Wherein hast thou loved us?”

Edom said, “We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places.” Living in the Caucasus Mountains and in the caves, they came back; it is called the Renaissance. They built major cities and took control of the whole earth. But “They shall build, but I will throw down”: the Lord, the God of war, will tear it down.

“they shall call them, The border of wickedness”: not him, but them, all of them. There is not one righteous Edomite in that verse, and no one can make the Bible say what it does not say. They are “The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.” Indignation is anger aroused by something unjust, unworthy, and Esau is both. Forever means forever. If the Lord has indignation against them forever, the Christian who argues they can be saved has been drugged by his religion.

note.label: Edom: The Robbers of thy people revealed past and present

precepts.why:
Esau left Canaan because his riches and cattle were too great for him and Jacob to dwell together, and the land did not belong to him. “Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.” But Genesis 14:6 had already shown that the Horites dwelt in Mount Seir. So what became of them?

Genesis 36 lists the dukes of Esau's sons, the high titles: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz, Korah, Gatam and Amalek, all of Eliphaz, Esau's firstborn by Adah. Remember these dukes, because they are all around today under various names like German, Israeli and Polish. Then comes a surprise: “These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,” “And Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan: these are the dukes of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.” Seir the Horite was a Hamite, and the Horites had dukes first. That is where Esau learned about dukes: he got among them, took their title and took their land.

Deuteronomy tells how: “The Horims also dwelt in Seir beforetime; but the children of Esau succeeded them, when they had destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their stead”. The Horims are the Horites, the same Hamite people. The children of Esau intermingled with them, then conquered them by the sword and dwelt in their place. So when you read about Seir it means Edom, but originally it was the land of the Horites, the children of Ham.

Moses adds, “as Israel did unto the land of his possession, which the Lord gave unto them.” Israel did the same in Canaan, but we did not kill off all the Canaanites; they kept living there. Esau did not waste any time. He killed them all out of there. That is the robber nature of Edom from the beginning: take the land, take the title, and destroy the people who were there.

precepts.text: Esau destroyed the Horims from before them and dwells in their stead unto this day: the conquered cave dwellers became cave dwellers.
precepts.point: Then the sons of Seir the Horite who inhabited the land, with their own dukes, Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer and Dishan. Esau learned dukes from the Horites, took the title and the land, and Seir the Hamite land became Edom.

note.label: Edom: The Robbers of thy people revealed past and present

precepts.why:
Moses says it a second time: “As he did to the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, when he destroyed the Horims from before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead even unto this day”. Esau destroyed the Horims and lived in their stead, and he is still there unto this day.

The name tells the rest. The Horims, or Horites, get their name from the Hebrew word for a cave or a hole, which shows they were known as cave dwellers, troglodytes, living in the mountains of Seir. These Hamites lived in the caves first. Esau went in, conquered the cave dwellers and became a cave dweller himself. And what does Caucasian mean? Cave dweller. Edom became a cave dweller. People say the white man is not Esau. Well, then who is he? Japheth? The hell he is. He is far from Japheth.

Malachi shows God's view of it: “yet I loved Jacob,” “And I hated Esau, and laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness.” Christian theologians say hated means preferred less, but that sounds just as bad; it means hate. The dragons of the wilderness are the Arabs, the Nabataeans, who later pushed much of Esau out of that land or intermarried with him. Mount Seir is called Petra today, meaning rock. Edom, rich in Canaan, became a poor cave dweller in Seir, saying, “We are impoverished,” but vowing to return and build the desolate places, and God calls them the border of wickedness, the people against whom he has indignation forever.

Obadiah describes the same people in the last days: “thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high”, the cave dweller, “Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle, and though thou set thy nest among the stars, thence will I bring thee down, saith the Lord.” The Greeks, the Romans, Spain, France, Russia, Britain and America all exalt the eagle, and all are Caucasian. Show us a powerful black nation today that came out of caves and exalts itself as the eagle. It fits one people: the Europeans, who took Seir from the Horites and dwell in their stead unto this day.

note.label: Zionism in the Face of Syria & Hezbollah

precepts.why:
The word of the Lord told Ezekiel, “Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it”. To know who Mount Seir is, go to Genesis 36. Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, his cattle and all his substance “and went into the country from the face of his brother Jacob”, because “the land wherein they were strangers could not bear them because of their cattle.” “Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.”

So prophesying against Mount Seir is prophesying against Edom. Mount Seir today is called Petra. The Arabs, the Nabataeans, took it over around the third or fourth century, but the scripture is speaking of Esau. Ezekiel 35 is not a prophecy against the Arabs; the whole chapter is about Esau.

Now the chapter reads plainly. God says he will make Mount Seir “most desolate”, “Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time that their iniquity had an end”. Any time our iniquity came to an end and we thought we would be all right, Esau came behind. When the Emancipation Proclamation said we were free and we started to build, Esau terrorized us with the Ku Klux Klan, Jim Crow and the black codes. They bombed our homes, flooded them, took our properties and live in them today. They tell us to go back to Africa while they rob Africa, yet in World War II they made laws forbidding blacks to fly to Ethiopia to help fight Mussolini. They do not really want us to leave.

“I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee: sith thou hast not hated blood”. Esau is a bloody race, going back to the red pottage of raw meat he begged Jacob for. God will fill his mountains with his slain men and make him “perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return”. Their cities are still here today, so this destruction of Edom has not happened yet.

“Because thou hast said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas the Lord was there”. The two nations are the kingdom of Judah and the kingdom of Israel. The two countries are the land of Israel and North America. Edom took the Americas in 1776 as Christians, calling themselves the anointed of God, and took the land of Israel in 1948 as Jews, calling themselves the praise of God, which is what Judah means. That is why God says to the wicked, “What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?” and Malachi calls Edom “The border of wickedness” and “The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.”

note.label: The Iranians & The Ephesians

precepts.why:
Ezra foretold that “the Carmanians raging in wrath shall go forth as the wild boars of the wood, and with great power shall they come, and join battle with them, and shall waste a portion of the land of the Assyrians.” The Carmanians are the Iranians: Carmania was a region of southeastern Iran, the modern province of Kerman, part of the Persian Empire, and Persia only formally became Iran in 1935. Why the Assyrians? In antiquity Assyria conquered Israel, took the northern kingdom, and moved into our land. That is exactly what Esau-Edom has done with our land today. They are not the rightful inhabitants; they are thieves, and the Lord is against them.

Ezekiel says so: “Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it”. Who is Mount Seir? “Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.” So the prophecy is against Esau-Edom, and the Lord says, “I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.”

Why? “Because thou hast said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it”. The two nations are the northern kingdom, Ephraim, and the southern kingdom, Judah: they took those two nations by identity theft, robbing us of who we are. The two countries are the United States of America and Israel. The children of Israel were in both first, and the whole world was made for our sake, but Edom stole both lands.

They said, “and we will possess it; whereas the Lord was there”. They possess it as if the Lord were with them, by calling themselves Jews and Christians. So “I will even do according to thine anger, and according to thine envy which thou hast used out of thy hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them, when I have judged thee.” The same way they hate the Israelites, the so-called Blacks, Hispanics and Native Americans, the Lord will use that same anger against them, and they will know that God did it.

Christ names them too: “I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.” He knows our poverty, “but thou art rich”, because the promises and the covenant belong to us.

note.label: Christ: the Enemy of Christianity

precepts.why:
Moses settles who Mount Seir is: “Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.” So when the Lord tells Ezekiel, “Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it,” the prophecy is against Esau, Edom. “Behold, O mount Seir, I am against thee” means God is against Esau-Edom.

Mount Seir itself is the place called Petra today, and nobody lives there. It is a rock with the same Roman-style structures you see on courthouses in America. God is not prophesying against a rock. He is prophesying against the people who once lived there, wherever they have gone. “I will lay thy cities waste” speaks of the other cities Esau-Edom built, which God still calls Mount Seir. “I will fill his mountains with his slain men: in thy hills, and in thy valleys” means wherever Edom is, his great governments and his smaller ones.

Then God gives the reason: “Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity”. Perpetual means everlasting. Our people ask why white folks hate us so, when we never did anything to them. God answers: they have always hated us, because that is how he made them. We thought our iniquity had an end at the so-called emancipation, and Edom made a new thing, the KKK, whose hoods, crosses and cross-burning came out of Spain and the Spanish Inquisition, when they were murdering black people, the Jews. Look at the capirotes of Spain and the KKK: the same damn thing, the same damn group. The whites from Spain brought that dress code to America and terrorized Negroes, and Negroes ain't put one and one together yet. That is why calling Christianity white supremacy is literal.

So God has prepared him: “I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee”, a violent life and a coming destruction. “I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return”. And the boast that condemns him: “These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it”. Those two nations are Judah and Israel, and the two countries are Israel and America: Edom took America as Christians and took the land of Israel as the Jews.

Ezekiel 36:5 makes it plain: God has spoken “against the residue of the heathen, and against all Idumea, which have appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all their heart, with despiteful minds, to cast it out for a prey.” Idumea is the Greek and Roman name for Edom. It does not say Japheth took the land; it says Idumea. So you're either going to go with what God said or what some negro on YouTube says. The Bible says Edom and their own scholars say Edom, so why are negroes going, no, it's Japheth? Esau put these things in his own books because he only expected his own people to read them. Their scholars agree: medieval chroniclers said Edom means the Roman Empire and the European powers, and Benjamin of Tudela called Rome the Edomite capital and the Pope the head of the Edomite religion, which is Christianity. This whole chapter reveals which race took the land of Israel and the land called America: Esau-Edom.

precepts.text: Amalek was born to Eliphaz, Esau's son, showing Aman's descent from Esau, who is Edom.
precepts.point: The teaching traces who Aman was. He is the same Aman promoted in the canonical book, an Agagite, and the Agagites descend from Agag king of the Amalekites, and Amalek descends from Esau. This is the lineage that has warred against Israel throughout history and has always been unsuccessful, for the Most High delivered his people.

note.label: Esther 12: Mardocheus Uncovers the Plot and Aman's Hatred

precepts.why:
The line goes one step further back. “Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau’s son; and she bare to Eliphaz Amalek”. Amalek was born to Eliphaz, Esau's son, so Amalek descends from Esau, who is Edom. The Amalekites come from Amalek, Agag was their king, and Aman the Agagite comes from Agag.

That is who was in great honour with the king and sought to molest Mardocheus and his people: a son of Esau. This is the lineage that has warred against Israel throughout history, and it has always been unsuccessful, because the Most High delivered his people.

Edom: The Robbers of thy people revealed past and present

points: Now these are the generations of Esau, who is Edom. That is all this verse is for: Esau is Edom.

Reading shown on Edom: an ancient kingdom that stretched across the area in the south of present-day Israel, Jordan, and Palestine. Once pushed out of their territories, the Edomites settled during the Persian period in the southern hills of Judea down to the area north of Beersheba, and the people appeared under a Greek form of their old name as Idumaeans, their new territory called Idumaea, a term used in the Hellenistic and Roman periods and mentioned in the New Testament.
Image shown: the Treasury carved into the rock at Mount Seir, an Edomite stronghold.

note.label: Edom: The Greatly Despised

points: Esau, who is Edom, took wives of the daughters of Canaan, Hittite and Hivite, against his parents, and when they were angry he married Bashemath, Ishmael's daughter, which was still bad; that is why so many light-skinned Arabs are Esau, and Nebajoth's line became the Nabataeans.

note.label: Edom: The Robbers of thy people revealed past and present

points: His sons were born in Canaan, the land promised to Jacob, where the brothers shared the land after he calmed down and both grew very rich. Then he went from the face of his brother, because their riches were more than they could dwell together and the land was not his, and dwelt in Mount Seir, where the Horites were.

note.label: Edom: The Robbers of thy people revealed past and present

points: The dukes of the sons of Esau: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz, Korah, Gatam and Amalek, all sons of Eliphaz, his firstborn. Remember them; they are around today under names like German, Israeli and Polish.

note.label: Edom: The Robbers of thy people revealed past and present

points: Then the sons of Seir the Horite who inhabited the land, with their own dukes, Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer and Dishan. Esau learned dukes from the Horites, took the title and the land, and Seir the Hamite land became Edom.

note.label: Edom: The Robbers of thy people revealed past and present

points: Now these are the generations of Esau, who is Edom. Esau is Edom, and this teaching identifies Edom with the people called the white man today.

Esau came out of the womb red, all over like an hairy garment; his blood could be seen through his skin for lack of melanin, and his name Esau goes into wasted away. Jacob was not described, because Jacob looked like everyone from Adam down to his time; the man of melanin needed no description.
Esau was called Edom, which means red, because he sold his birthright for that same red pottage.

note.label: Genesis 36: The Generations of Esau, Who Is Edom

points: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan and of Ishmael. He was the first of the Edomites; there were no women of his nation yet, so his lineage began through those wives. Genesis is Bereshith, the beginning of nations.

note.label: Genesis 36: The Generations of Esau, Who Is Edom

points: Esau went from the face of his brother because their riches were more than that they might dwell together, the same as with Abram and Lot in Genesis 13. Esau was rich at this time, out of the house of Isaac and Abraham.

note.label: Genesis 36: The Generations of Esau, Who Is Edom

points: Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir. Mount Seir is the clefts of the rock; the vision of Obadiah speaks to Edom as thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose pride hath deceived him.

note.label: Genesis 36: The Generations of Esau, Who Is Edom

points: Esau is the father of the Edomites in mount Seir, and his grandson Teman, son of Eliphaz, is identified in this teaching with Germany; the reference work Edom and Germany lays that connection out.

The prophecy over Teman stands: the wise men shall be destroyed out of Edom and understanding out of the mount of Esau, and the mighty men of Teman shall be dismayed. Much of the world's science and weapons technology has come out of Germany, and the word says that wisdom will be destroyed.

note.label: Genesis 36: The Generations of Esau, Who Is Edom

points: Timna was concubine to Eliphaz, and she bare Amalek. Amalek came of a concubine, a lesser wife, which is why the word bastard is studied here: in the scriptures it means a child of incest or one born outside the proper marriage.
The word says a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod, and Ashdod is the area of modern day Tel Aviv; this teaching places the line of Amalek dwelling there today.

note.label: Genesis 36: The Generations of Esau, Who Is Edom

points: These were the dukes of the sons of Esau: dukes are the chiefs of their tribes, the leaders of the families of Edom.

note.label: Genesis 36: The Generations of Esau, Who Is Edom

points: The sons of Seir the Horite inhabited the land before Esau; the Horites were the original dwellers of mount Seir.

note.label: Genesis 36: The Generations of Esau, Who Is Edom

points: These are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before there reigned any king over the children of Israel. Israel had no king until Saul, whom the Lord sought out when Israel asked for a king like the nations, in 1 Samuel 8 and 9.
